ns0:entry.ns0:title: chore(mypy): one ruleset for the whole codebase and mypy 2.3.1 (#4766)
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
chore(mypy): one ruleset for the whole codebase and mypy 2.3.1 (#4766)

* chore(mypy): collapse per-module overrides into one ruleset

Every module except lerobot.rl now passes the gate, so the 25 per-module override blocks are replaced by a single [tool.mypy] ruleset for all checked code. The only exceptions are lerobot.rl (not typed yet) and the vendored molmoact2_hf_model. The package root (__init__, __version__) is now checked too and already passes.

The disallow_untyped_defs / disallow_incomplete_defs / check_untyped_defs flags that only five modules carried are dropped; stricter settings will be adopted repo-wide instead of per module. The obsolete "enable mypy gradually" TODO is removed and the AGENTS.md mypy note is updated.

* chore(mypy): enable the strictness checks that already pass everywhere

warn_redundant_casts, extra_checks and strict_bytes (the mypy 2.x default) plus the deprecated, exhaustive-match, redundant-self, truthy-iterable and unused-awaitable error codes report nothing on the current code, so they are adopted repo-wide at no cost and guard new code from now on.

* chore(mypy): run the pre-commit hook on the whole tree

The hook passed only the staged files, and with follow_imports = skip every other module became Any, so local commits reported about 43 errors that CI (--all-files) never sees, e.g. "Cannot determine type of calibration" on a robot file checked without robot.py. The hook now sets pass_filenames: false and [tool.mypy] lists the checked paths, so a clean checkout analyses the same 557 files locally and in CI. exclude_gitignore keeps ignored scratch files out; untracked files under those paths are still checked.

The hook's files pattern mirrors that list and includes pyproject.toml, so config-only changes run it too. The generated gRPC modules (_pb2.py, _pb2_grpc.py) are excluded, as they already are from ruff. The stale "Uncomment when ready to use" TODO above the hook is removed, and AGENTS.md now says what the gate checks and how to run it.

* chore(mypy): enable strict_equality

strict_equality reports comparisons that can never be true. Its only hit was LiberoProcessorStep.transform_features, which compared PipelineFeatureType keys against FeatureType.STATE: the filter never matched, a stray FeatureType.STATE key was added and the observation group never got observation.state. It now rebuilds the observation group around the flattened 8-dim state, like the xvla LiberoProcessorStep. Nothing in src calls this method today; a test pins the corrected output.

* chore(mypy): enable local_partial_types

local_partial_types stops mypy from inferring a module-level None variable's type from uses in other scopes; mypy 2.x enables it by default. Its only hit was wall_x PRIORITY_ORDER, now annotated as the OrderedDict | None that get_task_instruction accepts.

* chore(mypy): enable the truthy-bool error code

truthy-bool reports objects used in a boolean context although they are always truthy (no __bool__/__len__), which is how an `if obj:` meant as a None check silently passes. Both hits were dead checks: create_camera_instance tested `if instance:` after every branch had assigned a camera (its trailing return was unreachable), and the rollout teleop log line re-checked cfg.teleop inside an `is not None` block.

* chore(mypy): disable implicit re-exports

With implicit_reexport = false a name is only importable from a module that defines it or lists it in __all__, which enforces canonical imports. Six importers reached a name through a module that merely imported it and now import it from where it is defined (lerobot_types, utils.import_utils, utils.io_utils, fastwam wan.model, bi_so_leader's config module).

wall_x.qwen_model drops the transformers Qwen2_5_VLVisionConfig from its imports and __all__. Its config module never re-exported the class and nothing imports it from there, but it was a declared public name: import it from transformers instead.

* chore(mypy): warn about unused type: ignore comments

warn_unused_ignores reports suppressions that no longer suppress anything, so stale ignores cannot pile up or hide a later real error on the same line. It flagged 36, 32 of them already stale on main:
- 18 import-line ignores (incl. the camera 'TODO: add type stubs' ones) made redundant by ignore_missing_imports; the two after a noqa on the VLABench imports, which mypy never parsed, go too;
- 3 protobuf attr-defined ignores, redundant now that the generated _pb2 modules are excluded;
- 8 for error codes the ruleset does not enable: no-untyped-def (reader.frames_df gets a return annotation), type-arg (the *_delta_indices properties return list[int]) and no-any-return;
- 7 on expressions or class lines whose operand is Any in the gate (the push_to_hub shadowing keeps its rename TODO).

The six yaml/requests import ignores move to a per-module ignore_missing_imports override: mypy 1.19.1 needs it and mypy 2.x accepts it, so bumping the pinned mypy will not report them as unused.

* chore(mypy): require error codes on type: ignore comments

The ignore-without-code error code rejects a bare `# type: ignore`, which silences every error on its line instead of the one intended. After the unused-ignore cleanup a single bare ignore remained, on spec.loader in the hub env loader; spec.loader is None is now part of the existing ImportError guard, so the ignore is gone. spec_from_file_location always sets a loader when it returns a spec, so behaviour is unchanged.

* chore(mypy): list the next strictness candidates in the ruleset

warn_unreachable, strict_equality_for_none and check_untyped_defs are worth enabling next but each needs a fix PR first; the ruleset now records them with their current error counts and the caveat that matters for each.

* chore(mypy): bump mypy to 2.3.1

pre-commit ran mypy 1.19.1 while the dev extra (mypy>=1.19.1) already resolved to 2.3.1, so `pre-commit` and `uv run mypy` could disagree. The hook now pins mirrors-mypy v2.3.1 and the dev extra allows the whole 2.x line (>=2.0.0,<3.0.0); the lockfile keeps 2.3.1.

2.3.1 reports two errors that 1.19.1 missed, both fixed without changing behaviour:
- OpenCVCamera._validate_fourcc unpacked the Optional config.fourcc; it now binds it locally and raises if it is None (both callers already check it).
- DatasetReader's column-view cache compared hf_dataset against an Optional attribute with `is not`, which newer mypy uses to re-widen hf_dataset; the comparison now goes through a local.

mypy 2.x no longer reports yaml/requests as untyped under the global ignore_missing_imports, so their override is dropped, and the warn_unreachable candidate count is updated to what 2.3.1 reports (40).

ns0:entry.ns0:content:
chore(mypy): cover robot (#4754)

* chore(mypy): cover lerobot_types

Replace `TransitionKey(str, Enum)` with a `@final` constants class whose members
are `Final[Literal[...]]` strings, and rewrite `EnvTransition` as a class-based
`TypedDict` with the seven literal keys (all required). mypy cannot index a
TypedDict with a str-Enum member (it reports the member NAME as a missing key)
and rejects non-literal field names in the functional `TypedDict(...)` form, so
the old definitions left `EnvTransition` with no usable fields for every module
that handles transitions. With the new spelling `td[TransitionKey.X]`,
`.get(...)`, `.copy()` and dict literals keyed by `TransitionKey.X` type-check
with no call-site changes. The explicit `Final[Literal["x"]]` form (rather than
the implicit `Final = "x"`) keeps the literal type when a member is bound to a
local or a tuple variable; only a `list` of members widens to `list[str]`.
`PolicyAction` and `EnvAction` get an explicit `TypeAlias` because their
torch/numpy targets resolve to `Any` under the CI mypy config
(`follow_imports = skip`, no stubs); a PEP 695 `type` statement is not usable
since both are `isinstance` targets.

Enable the `lerobot.lerobot_types` mypy override in pyproject.toml and drop the
Enum-only `.value` accesses and the `isinstance(k, TransitionKey)` assertion in
tests: tests/processor/{test_act,test_diffusion,test_gaussian_actor,
test_smolvla,test_tdmpc,test_vqbet}_processor.py, tests/processor/test_pipeline.py,
tests/rewards/test_classifier_processor.py, tests/test_interactive_rollout.py.

BREAKING (intentional, no compat shim): `TransitionKey` is no longer an `Enum`.
`TransitionKey("observation")`, `TransitionKey["OBSERVATION"]`,
`list(TransitionKey)`, `"observation" in TransitionKey`, `.value` / `.name` and
`__members__` now raise; `isinstance(x, TransitionKey)` is always False; `str()`
/ f-strings render `"observation"` instead of `"TransitionKey.OBSERVATION"`.
Nothing in src/, tests/, examples/ or docs/ used these. Consequences:
- Pickles of transitions written by older versions fail to load with
  `TypeError: TransitionKey() takes no arguments` (Enum reduce calls the class);
  no in-repo cross-version path exists. `torch.load(weights_only=True)` of a
  transition, which failed on Enum keys, now works.
- `ValueError("Cannot filter batched field ...")` in
  processor/render_messages_processor.py now names `'observation.foo'` /
  `'action'` instead of `'TransitionKey.OBSERVATION.foo'`; no test pins the text.
- `EnvTransition.__annotations__` holds lazy strings (the module already uses
  `from __future__ import annotations`); use `typing.get_type_hints`.

Left for the not-yet-gated modules' own PRs: rewards/{topreward,robometer}/
compute_rabc_weights.py and policies/lawam/processor_lawam.py pass partial dict
literals where an `EnvTransition` is expected (mypy: Missing keys), and
processor/device_processor.py iterates *lists* of keys, which widen to `str`.

* chore(mypy): cover robots

Enable the lerobot.robots.* mypy override (54 CI-gate errors -> 0).

Optional connection state (zmq context/sockets, threads, the B601 motor bus) is now
annotated at declaration and narrowed with DeviceNotConnectedError guards; calibration
ticks are coerced to int for MotorCalibration; the kinematic processor copies the total
EnvTransition TypedDict as one and keeps tolerant .get() reads of complementary_data;
robot locals/attributes use the shared RobotObservation/RobotAction/Camera types. New
DepthCamera runtime-checkable Protocol in lerobot.cameras replaces getattr(cam, "use_depth")
duck typing at the eight depth-read sites and in so_follower._cameras_ft, so observation
features and get_observation() share one predicate (regression test added). lekiwi_client
uses the module-top _zmq_available/require_package guard. One type: ignore[import-untyped]
(requests stubs absent from the pre-commit env).

ns0:entry.ns0:title: Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs (#4732)
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs (#4732)

A tag is mutable: whoever controls the action's repository can move
`v4` to different code, and the next run picks it up with no diff to
review. Pinning to the commit SHA freezes the code that runs today.

Enable the `lerobot.lerobot_types` mypy override in pyproject.toml and drop the
Enum-only `.value` accesses and the `isinstance(k, TransitionKey)` assertion in
tests: tests/processor/{test_act,test_diffusion,test_gaussian_actor,
test_smolvla,test_tdmpc,test_vqbet}_processor.py, tests/processor/test_pipeline.py,
tests/rewards/test_classifier_processor.py, tests/test_interactive_rollout.py.

BREAKING (intentional, no compat shim): `TransitionKey` is no longer an `Enum`.
`TransitionKey("observation")`, `TransitionKey["OBSERVATION"]`,
`list(TransitionKey)`, `"observation" in TransitionKey`, `.value` / `.name` and
`__members__` now raise; `isinstance(x, TransitionKey)` is always False; `str()`
/ f-strings render `"observation"` instead of `"TransitionKey.OBSERVATION"`.
Nothing in src/, tests/, examples/ or docs/ used these. Consequences:
- Pickles of transitions written by older versions fail to load with
  `TypeError: TransitionKey() takes no arguments` (Enum reduce calls the class);
  no in-repo cross-version path exists. `torch.load(weights_only=True)` of a
  transition, which failed on Enum keys, now works.
- `ValueError("Cannot filter batched field ...")` in
  processor/render_messages_processor.py now names `'observation.foo'` /
  `'action'` instead of `'TransitionKey.OBSERVATION.foo'`; no test pins the text.
- `EnvTransition.__annotations__` holds lazy strings (the module already uses
  `from __future__ import annotations`); use `typing.get_type_hints`.

Left for the not-yet-gated modules' own PRs: rewards/{topreward,robometer}/
compute_rabc_weights.py and policies/lawam/processor_lawam.py pass partial dict
literals where an `EnvTransition` is expected (mypy: Missing keys), and
processor/device_processor.py iterates *lists* of keys, which widen to `str`.
